purpose: This silver table provides a cleaned registry of aircraft tail numbers appearing among the 2013 NYC flights, sourced from the FAA's 2014 aircraft registry release, so downstream consumers can enrich flight records with aircraft characteristics.
usage: Join on tailnum to attach type, manufacturer, model, engines, seats, engine_type, year, and speed_mph to flight records; consumers must treat year (2.1% null) and especially speed_mph (99.3% null) as optionally populated and should not filter rows solely on their nullness.
limitations: speed_mph is populated for only about 0.7% of rows (null_rate 0.993076) and should not be relied upon as a general attribute; year is missing for 2.1% of rows (70 of 3322); per operator context, American Airlines and Envoy Air aircraft are absent from this registry extract because those carriers reported fleet numbers rather than tail numbers; no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied.
